evals.prompt: Users click 'New Email' and the compose window never opens. Audit the inbox buttons and fix what is broken.
expectations: The agent maps the store's actions with what each sets and what it resets as a side effect, finding that selectThread resets composeMode
The agent traces each inbox button handler (New Email, Archive, Open), not only the reported one
The agent names the New Email defect as a sequential undo: setComposeMode(true) is cancelled by the following selectThread(null)
The fix makes New Email leave composeMode true, and a test proves it
